title: REMOTE Junior Backend JavaScript Developer
description:
We are looking for a Junior Backend JavaScript Developer to join our remote development team. They should have good knowledge in JavaScript and have good mathematical and problem problem-solving abilities.

The ideal person will have a good eye for detail, be able to deal with the pressure of deadline driven deliveries, be motivated to continually improve, and relish working as part of a remote team. This is an ideal opportunity to learn and gain experience in game development and work up to a more senior role inside a rapidly growing business within a team of proven industry experts, developers, and artists.

Main Responsibilities

• Working closely with the Head of Game Production, Mathematician, and Backend Lead Developer, the primary responsibilities of the role will be to:

• Prototype and demo innovative new game features in TypeScript and JavaScript

• Develop simulation tools that will simulate and calculate gameplay probabilities

• Assist in communicating with, directing, and managing outsourced game development teams

• Assist in the creation of new game ideas

Skills

• JavaScript

• Highly intelligent with a passion and ability to solve problems

• Strong communication skills; fluent in English

• Fun to work with

• Ability and equipment to work remotely.

Nice to have

• Experience with Node.js. Electron is a strong advantage

• Knowledge of modern HTML and CSS, ES6+, Canvas, or WebGL

• Experience with libraries such as PIXI.js, Easel.js, or TweenMax

• Knowledge of other programming languages: C#, Java, C++, etc.

• Experience with any Version Control System, in particular Git with GitHub

• Experience with containers and Docker

• Experience with Webpack

• Has played or enjoyed slot games, and / or other gambling games

• Plays and enjoys card games / board games / puzzle or strategy-based video games as well as other video games

• Degree in Computer Science, Maths or Statistical education

Who we are
4ThePlayer.com is an up-and-coming creator of online gambling games (slots, table games and others). The company was founded in 2018 by two luminaries of the gambling gaming industry, Chris Ash and Andrew Porter, who have a combined 40 years of gaming industry experience. 4ThePlayer has been tipped for significant success, winning industry awards and rapidly increasing our reputation for a forward-thinking approach to game design. We are on track for exponential growth and to become an industry leader.
Play our games here: https://www.4theplayer.com/our-games/

What we offer

• 100% remote work – flexible full time working hours with respect to your work life balance

• Opportunity to learn from the best in the industry and to continuously upgrade your skill sets

• Your work will entertain millions of players around the world!

• Please follow our social for more company information:

• LinkedIn

• Twitter

• YouTube

• Facebook

title: Backend Python Engineer
description:
Backend Python Engineer (AI Training)

About The Role

What if your Python expertise could directly shape how the world's most advanced AI systems write and reason about code? We're looking for experienced Backend Python Engineers to evaluate AI-generated code, build complex algorithmic challenges, and help push the boundaries of what AI can do with software.

This is a fully remote, flexible contract role built for senior Python developers who want meaningful, high-impact work alongside cutting-edge AI research labs — on their own schedule.

• Organization: Alignerr
• Type: Hourly Contract
• Location: Remote
• Commitment: 10–40 hours/week

What You'll Do

• Review and evaluate AI-generated Python code for correctness, efficiency, and adherence to PEP 8 and industry best practices
• Design and develop complex backend algorithmic solutions and data processing scripts that challenge AI reasoning at its limits
• Write clear, human-readable explanations of backend logic, architectural decisions, and code quality judgements
• Identify edge cases, security vulnerabilities, and failure modes in AI-generated API logic
• Provide structured, expert-level feedback that directly informs how AI models learn to write better code

Who You Are

• Deep expertise in Python, including modern frameworks such as Django, Flask, and FastAPI
• 3–5+ years of professional experience writing production-level Python code
• Strong grasp of advanced Python language features, performance considerations, and software design principles
• Exceptional written communication skills — you can explain complex technical concepts clearly and precisely
• Bachelor's degree or higher in Computer Science or a related technical field
• Self-motivated and comfortable working independently in an async environment

Nice to Have

• Prior experience with data annotation, RLHF, or AI evaluation workflows
• Background in API security, distributed systems, or data engineering
• Familiarity with software testing methodologies and edge case analysis

Why Join Us

• Work directly with leading AI research labs on some of the most technically demanding projects in the field
• Fully remote and flexible — work when and where suits you best
• Freelance autonomy with the structure of meaningful, task-based work
• Make a tangible impact on how AI understands, writes, and reasons about real-world code
• Potential for ongoing work and contract extension as new projects launch

title: Backend Rust Developer
description:
Backend Rust Developer (AI Training)

About The Role

What if your deep expertise in Rust could directly shape how AI understands and generates systems-level code for developers around the world? We're looking for experienced Rust developers to evaluate AI-generated code, challenge its limits, and help build smarter, safer AI systems from the ground up.

This is a fully remote, flexible contract role built for seasoned systems programmers who know what good Rust looks like — and exactly when it falls short.

• Organization: Alignerr
• Type: Hourly Contract
• Location: Remote
• Commitment: 10–40 hours/week

What You'll Do

• Review AI-generated Rust code for correctness, memory safety, and ownership pattern compliance
• Design and write high-performance systems-level code to benchmark AI understanding of low-level constraints
• Evaluate concurrent programming logic and identify potential race conditions or undefined behavior in AI outputs
• Assess AI responses for type safety, scientific rigor, and adherence to idiomatic Rust
• Provide clear, structured feedback that helps AI models improve at the systems programming level
• Work independently and asynchronously — fully on your own schedule

Who You Are

• 5+ years of professional experience writing production-grade Rust with a focus on memory safety and concurrency
• Strong background in systems programming and performance optimization
• Deep understanding of Rust's ownership model, lifetimes, and concurrency primitives
• Able to clearly explain complex low-level programming concepts in writing
• Bachelor's degree or higher in Computer Science or a related technical field
• Fluent in English — you communicate technical ideas with precision and clarity

Nice to Have

• Experience with distributed systems architecture or developer tooling
• Familiarity with unsafe Rust and the trade-offs involved
• Background in compiler design, embedded systems, or OS-level programming
• Prior exposure to AI code generation tools or code review workflows

Why Join Us

• Work on cutting-edge AI projects alongside leading research labs and AI teams
• Fully remote and flexible — work when and where it suits you
• Freelance autonomy with the structure of meaningful, task-based work
• Make a direct, tangible impact on how AI understands and generates systems-level code
• Potential for ongoing work and contract extension as new projects launch
